job_title: Customer Service Team Leader - ( Trưởng Nhóm Chăm Sóc Khách Hàng ) 16,600,000–24,400,000 - Yêu Cầu Nữ
location: Hồ Chí Minh: Victory Tower số 12 Tân Trào, Phường Tân Mỹ (Phường Tân Mỹ thuộc Quận 7 cũ)
benefits: 5 days off per month + 6 days of menstrual leave per year.
Monthly afternoon tea, snacks, and various employee benefits.
Regular team meals and internal team-building activities.
A friendly working environment, a collaborative team, and opportunities for personal and professional development.
Team building, Du lịch hàng năm
description:
1. Team Management
* Assign, coordinate, and supervise daily tasks among team members.
* Monitor work progress, productivity, and team discipline.
* Handle operational issues and ensure smooth team operations.
2. Performance Management
* Monitor and evaluate individual and team performance based on KPIs.
* Propose solutions to improve team productivity and work efficiency.
3. Training & Development
* Train and guide new employees on work procedures and job responsibilities.
* Monitor the development and performance of new employees during probation.
4. Quality Control & Reporting
* Conduct regular checks to ensure work quality and compliance with procedures.
* Report team performance and operational issues to upper management.
5. Process Improvement
- Identify and implement improvements to optimize workflows and operational efficiency.
requirements_text:
* Female applicants only
* English proficiency equivalent to TOEIC 700+ or IELTS 6.0 and above.
* At least 6 months of experience in team management, team supervision, or coordination.
Basic skills in reporting, data consolidation, and data analysis.
* Ability to train, guide, and support new employees throughout their onboarding process.
* Strong sense of responsibility, proactive working attitude, and ability to work under pressure.
* Flexibility to work on rotating shifts (Morning – Afternoon – Night).
Morning Shift: 7:00 AM – 4:00 PM
Afternoon Shift: 3:00 PM – 12:00 AM
Night Shift: 11:00 PM – 8:00 AM
Kỹ năng cần có
Communication, Problem-solving, Data Analysis, Reporting, Training, Decision-Making, Data consolidation
